'''Oll Maccabe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who had been a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of anthropology at the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan University]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Having been offworld at the time, Maccabe became a supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Later on, he enlisted the help of one of his students, [[Padija Anjeri]], in recovering stolen Twi'leki artifacts.<ref name="SF" />
